A Halloween voice over to scare you

Need a spooky Halloween voiceover for your production? Get your show, podcast, promos and radio imaging ready for Halloween with a fast, fun delivery. I’m the voice of Ghost Face, Dracula, The Director at Alton Towers Scarefest, and The Spooky Voice of Heart.

And if you need something darker, check out my Joker Voice — made famous in The Dark Knight by Heath Ledger.

The Premier Halloween Voice Actor in the UK

From Thorpe Park’s legendary Fright Nights to Alton Towers’ Scarefest, I’m one of the UK’s go-to voices for all things Halloween. Whether you need eerie narration, a sinister villain, or full Vincent Price-style drama, I’ve voiced it.

I specialise in chilling, atmospheric reads — from PURE EVIL to comedic spooky characters like Spooky Halloween Laughs. My Halloween range covers promos, radio ads, trailers, and theme park events across the UK.

Spooky Halloween Voice Showreel – Guy Harris

Mastering Iconic Voices: The Joker from The Dark Knight

Regarded as one of cinema’s greatest villains, Heath Ledger’s Joker is a voice every impressionist knows — and few can get right. I’ve honed this unsettling sound-alike for trailers, horror promos and Halloween creatives.

If your project needs something dark, chaotic and unmistakably Joker, check out the YouTube demo and get in touch.

Fast, High-Quality Spooky Voiceovers from a State-of-the-Art Studio

When time matters, most Halloween scripts are voiced the same day — all from my broadcast-quality studio. For pricing, just send your script and usage details and I’ll respond quickly.

From Ghost Face to Dracula, Joker, and even Wilhelm Scream-style effects, my Halloween range covers everything from evil characters to tongue-in-cheek spooky reads.

As one of the UK’s most in-demand male Halloween voiceover artists, I also voice commercials, game trailers, cartoons and theme park announcements.

Need it urgently? Get in touch.

Need a voice for something similar? Send me a quick message and I'll get back to you.
